text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of boys who have completed school, by education level
The share of boys who are three to five years older than the official age for the last grade of primary, lower
secondary, and upper secondary education who have successfully completed it. This broader age band is used
to include children who started school late or had to resit particular years.
